item.title: Never Trump Republicans are still issuing dire warnings. Is anyone listening?
item.description: Over and over, the Republicans and former Republicans who gathered just outside Washington this weekend warned that President Donald Trump and his allies in Congress are tearing at the very fabric of American democracy.

item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel during operation to capture him
item.description: The Mexican army killed the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, Nemesio Rubén Oseguera Cervantes, “El Mencho, ” on Sunday, decapitating what had become Mexico's most powerful cartel and giving the government its biggest prize yet to show the Trump administration its efforts.

item.title: TSA shuts down Global Entry as the partial government shutdown drags on
item.description: The Transportation Security Administration said Sunday that the Global Entry program would be shut down as long as the partial government shutdown remains in effect.

item.title: Largest nurses strike in New York City history ends as holdout workers ratify contract
item.description: The largest nurses strike in New York City history ended this weekend when the last holdouts in the 41-day labor action overwhelmingly voted to ratify a contract and agreed to return to work, officials said.

item.title: Highway Patrol Trooper killed in car crash in Robeson County
item.description: Highway Patrol says Master Trooper Stein Davis was on duty, driving down NC 130 just after midnight, when he lost control of his patrol vehicle.

item.title: Sparks fly during Chadbourn Town Council emergency meeting, leaves town without an attorney or manager
item.description: On Saturday, Mayor Pro Tem Tony Jordan called an emergency meeting for the town of Chadbourn without consulting the town manager, Jason Robinson or Mayor Philip Britt.
